title: Coral and the Crown
author: Cyrus Quintana
blurb: Emrys Pemberton, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
